```{r}
# 0. Settings
# ---------------------------
DATA_DIR <- "."
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "A_Cox_outputs")
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "csv"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

required_packages <- c("survival", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace,
                                               logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(survival)
library(openxlsx)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Diagnostic-driven modeling settings
# Marriage Unknown is retained in the common data/QA, but excluded from Cox models
# because the current Ever sample contains only one Unknown interval/person/event.
MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL <- 5L

waves <- c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020)
start_waves <- c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018)
next_wave_lookup <- c("2011" = 2013, "2013" = 2015,
                      "2015" = 2018, "2018" = 2020)

input_files <- setNames(
  file.path(DATA_DIR, paste0("CHARLS_", waves, "_cleaned.csv")),
  waves
)

if (any(!file.exists(input_files))) {
  stop("Missing input file(s): ",
       paste(names(input_files)[!file.exists(input_files)], collapse = ", "))
}
```


```{r}
# 1. Small helper functions
# ---------------------------
first_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  x[1]
}

one_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  x[1]
}

safe_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

standardize_2011_individual_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- x
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 11
  out[idx] <- paste0(substr(x[idx], 1, 9), "0", substr(x[idx], 10, 11))
  out
}

standardize_2011_household_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- x
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 9
  out[idx] <- paste0(x[idx], "0")
  out
}

recode_marriage <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[x %in% c(1, 2, 7)] <- "Partnered"
  out[x == 5] <- "Widowed"
  out[x %in% c(3, 4)] <- "Separated-Divorced"
  out[x == 6] <- "Never married"
  factor(out,
         levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced",
                    "Never married", "Unknown"))
}

recode_children <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 0] <- "0"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 1] <- "1"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 2] <- "2"
  out[!is.na(x) & x >= 3] <- "3+"
  factor(out, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown"))
}

recode_coresidence <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 0] <- "No"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 1] <- "Yes"
  factor(out, levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))
}

recode_age_group <- function(x) {
  cut(x,
      breaks = c(45, 55, 65, 75, 85, 95, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74",
                 "75-84", "85-94", "95+"))
}

fit_cox_with_warnings <- function(formula, data) {
  warnings_seen <- character(0)
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(formula,
          data = data,
          ties = "efron",
          cluster = individual_id,
          robust = TRUE,
          x = TRUE,
          model = TRUE),
    warning = function(w) {
      warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings_seen))
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit)
  coef_table <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
  ci_table <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)

  out <- data.frame(
    term = rownames(coef_table),
    beta = coef_table[, "coef"],
    HR = ci_table[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower_95 = ci_table[, "lower .95"],
    upper_95 = ci_table[, "upper .95"],
    p_value = coef_table[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if ("robust se" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "robust se"]
  } else if ("se(coef)" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "se(coef)"]
  } else {
    out$robust_se <- NA_real_
  }

  out[, c("term", "beta", "robust_se", "HR",
          "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")]
}

wald_block <- function(fit, coefficient_names) {
  b_all <- coef(fit)
  coefficient_names <- intersect(coefficient_names, names(b_all))

  if (length(coefficient_names) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  b <- b_all[coefficient_names]
  V <- vcov(fit)[coefficient_names, coefficient_names, drop = FALSE]

  ok <- is.finite(b)
  if (!all(ok)) {
    b <- b[ok]
    V <- V[ok, ok, drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (length(b) == 0 || any(!is.finite(V))) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  ee <- eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE)
  tol <- max(abs(ee$values)) * 1e-10
  keep <- ee$values > tol
  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  Vinv <- ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE] %*%
    diag(1 / ee$values[keep], nrow = sum(keep)) %*%
    t(ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE])

  W <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% Vinv %*% b)
  df <- sum(keep)
  p <- pchisq(W, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  data.frame(chisq = W, df = df, p_value = p)
}

linear_combination_hr <- function(fit, weights, label) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)
  w <- rep(0, length(b))
  names(w) <- names(b)

  missing_terms <- setdiff(names(weights), names(b))
  if (length(missing_terms) > 0 || any(!is.finite(b[names(weights)])) ||
      any(!is.finite(V[names(weights), names(weights), drop = FALSE]))) {
    return(data.frame(label = label, log_HR = NA_real_, SE = NA_real_,
                      HR = NA_real_, lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_,
                      p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  w[names(weights)] <- weights
  est <- sum(w * b)
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(w) %*% V %*% w))
  z <- est / se

  data.frame(
    label = label,
    log_HR = est,
    SE = se,
    HR = exp(est),
    lower_95 = exp(est - 1.96 * se),
    upper_95 = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
}

safe_cox_zph <- function(fit) {
  tryCatch(
    cox.zph(fit, transform = "km", terms = TRUE, global = TRUE),
    error = function(e) structure(list(message = conditionMessage(e)),
                                 class = "cox_zph_error")
  )
}

ph_table <- function(ph_object) {
  if (inherits(ph_object, "cox_zph_error")) {
    return(data.frame(term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
                      chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
                      message = ph_object$message,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  x <- as.data.frame(ph_object$table)
  x$term <- rownames(x)
  rownames(x) <- NULL
  x[, c("term", setdiff(names(x), "term")), drop = FALSE]
}

make_cell_qa <- function(data, variable) {
  levs <- levels(data[[variable]])
  if (is.null(levs)) levs <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[variable]])))

  out <- lapply(levs, function(z) {
    d <- data[as.character(data[[variable]]) == z, , drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(
      variable = variable,
      level = z,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

add_sheet <- function(wb, name, x) {
  addWorksheet(wb, name)
  writeData(wb, name, x)
}


# Pretty, reader-facing version of the main Cox table.
make_readable_main_results <- function(x) {
  label_map <- c(
    "sexFemale" = "Female vs Male",
    "income_tertileT2" = "Income T2 vs T1",
    "income_tertileT3" = "Income T3 vs T1",
    "marriage_statusWidowed" = "Widowed vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced" = "Separated/Divorced vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusNever married" = "Never married vs Partnered",
    "living_children1" = "1 living child vs 0",
    "living_children2" = "2 living children vs 0",
    "living_children3+" = "3+ living children vs 0",
    "living_childrenUnknown" = "Living children Unknown vs 0",
    "coresident_childYes" = "Coresident child Yes vs No",
    "coresident_childUnknown" = "Coresident child Unknown vs No"
  )

  out <- x
  out$comparison <- ifelse(out$term %in% names(label_map),
                           unname(label_map[out$term]),
                           out$term)
  out$HR_95CI <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
                         out$HR, out$lower_95, out$upper_95)
  out$p_display <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$p_value), NA_character_,
    ifelse(out$p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", out$p_value))
  )
  out[, c("comparison", "HR_95CI", "p_display",
          "beta", "robust_se", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")]
}

make_sex_marriage_cell_qa <- function(data) {
  sexes <- levels(data$sex)
  marriages <- levels(data$marriage_status)
  grid <- expand.grid(
    sex = sexes,
    marriage_status = marriages,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    sx <- grid$sex[i]
    ms <- grid$marriage_status[i]
    d <- data[
      as.character(data$sex) == sx &
        as.character(data$marriage_status) == ms,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    data.frame(
      sex = sx,
      marriage_status = ms,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

# Run cox.zph on the clustered robust fit first.
# If the robust covariance is singular, fit the exact same Cox formula without
# cluster/robust ONLY for the PH diagnostic and label this fallback explicitly.
run_ph_diagnostic <- function(formula, data, clustered_fit) {
  primary <- safe_cox_zph(clustered_fit)

  if (!inherits(primary, "cox_zph_error")) {
    tab <- ph_table(primary)
    tab$diagnostic_source <- "clustered robust Cox fit"
    tab$primary_error <- NA_character_
    return(list(object = primary, table = tab,
                source = "clustered robust Cox fit",
                primary_error = NA_character_))
  }

  diagnostic_fit <- coxph(
    formula,
    data = data,
    ties = "efron",
    x = TRUE,
    model = TRUE
  )
  fallback <- safe_cox_zph(diagnostic_fit)
  tab <- ph_table(fallback)
  tab$diagnostic_source <- "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback"
  tab$primary_error <- primary$message

  list(object = fallback, table = tab,
       source = "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback",
       primary_error = primary$message)
}

print_table_section <- function(title, x, digits = 4) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(title, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No result available.\n")
  } else {
    print(x, row.names = FALSE, digits = digits)
  }
}


# ---------------------------
# 2. Read and standardize the five cleaned files
# ---------------------------
raw_list <- list()
id_qa <- list()

for (yr in waves) {
  f <- input_files[as.character(yr)]
  d <- read.csv(f,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                na.strings = c("", "NA"),
                colClasses = c(individual_id = "character",
                               household_id = "character",
                               community_id = "character"),
                check.names = FALSE)

  required_now <- c("individual_id", "household_id", "community_id",
                    "sex", "age", "marriage_status_raw",
                    paste0("death_", yr), paste0("dibao_", yr),
                    "num_children", "coresident_child",
                    "household_income_per_capita")
  missing_now <- setdiff(required_now, names(d))
  if (length(missing_now) > 0) {
    stop("Year ", yr, " is missing required column(s): ",
         paste(missing_now, collapse = ", "))
  }

  d$individual_id <- trimws(d$individual_id)
  d$household_id <- trimws(d$household_id)
  d$community_id <- trimws(d$community_id)

  before_ind_lengths <- table(nchar(d$individual_id), useNA = "ifany")
  before_hh_lengths <- table(nchar(d$household_id), useNA = "ifany")

  if (yr == 2011) {
    d$individual_id <- standardize_2011_individual_id(d$individual_id)
    d$household_id <- standardize_2011_household_id(d$household_id)
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(d$individual_id)) {
    stop("Duplicated individual_id detected after standardization in year ", yr)
  }

  after_ind_lengths <- table(nchar(d$individual_id), useNA = "ifany")
  after_hh_lengths <- table(nchar(d$household_id), useNA = "ifany")

  id_qa[[as.character(yr)]] <- data.frame(
    year = yr,
    rows = nrow(d),
    unique_individuals = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    unique_households = length(unique(d$household_id)),
    individual_length_before = paste(names(before_ind_lengths), before_ind_lengths,
                                     sep = ":", collapse = "; "),
    individual_length_after = paste(names(after_ind_lengths), after_ind_lengths,
                                    sep = ":", collapse = "; "),
    household_length_before = paste(names(before_hh_lengths), before_hh_lengths,
                                    sep = ":", collapse = "; "),
    household_length_after = paste(names(after_hh_lengths), after_hh_lengths,
                                   sep = ":", collapse = "; ")
  )

  raw_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- d
}

id_qa <- do.call(rbind, id_qa)

# Successive-wave ID matching QA
id_match_qa <- data.frame()
for (j in seq_len(length(waves) - 1)) {
  y1 <- waves[j]
  y2 <- waves[j + 1]
  a <- raw_list[[as.character(y1)]]$individual_id
  b <- raw_list[[as.character(y2)]]$individual_id
  id_match_qa <- rbind(id_match_qa,
                       data.frame(from_wave = y1,
                                  to_wave = y2,
                                  matched_individuals = length(intersect(a, b)),
                                  n_from = length(unique(a)),
                                  n_to = length(unique(b))))
}

# ---------------------------
# 3. Create one standardized person-wave table
# ---------------------------
person_wave_list <- list()

for (yr in waves) {
  d <- raw_list[[as.character(yr)]]

  get_or_na <- function(nm) {
    if (nm %in% names(d)) d[[nm]] else rep(NA, nrow(d))
  }

  pw <- data.frame(
    individual_id = d$individual_id,
    household_id = d$household_id,
    community_id = d$community_id,
    wave = yr,
    sex = safe_numeric(d$sex),
    age = safe_numeric(d$age),
    birth_year_used = safe_numeric(get_or_na("birth_year_used")),
    marriage_status_raw = safe_numeric(d$marriage_status_raw),
    num_children = safe_numeric(d$num_children),
    coresident_child_raw = safe_numeric(d$coresident_child),
    death = safe_numeric(d[[paste0("death_", yr)]]),
    dibao = safe_numeric(d[[paste0("dibao_", yr)]]),
    household_income_per_capita = safe_numeric(d$household_income_per_capita),
    death_year = safe_numeric(get_or_na("death_year")),
    death_month = safe_numeric(get_or_na("death_month")),
    household_income_module_missing =
      safe_numeric(get_or_na(paste0("household_income_module_missing_", yr))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (any(!is.na(pw$sex) & !(pw$sex %in% c(1, 2)))) {
    stop("Unexpected sex code in year ", yr)
  }
  if (any(!is.na(pw$death) & !(pw$death %in% c(0, 1)))) {
    stop("Unexpected death code in year ", yr)
  }
  if (any(!is.na(pw$dibao) & !(pw$dibao %in% c(0, 1)))) {
    stop("Unexpected Dibao code in year ", yr)
  }
  if (any(!is.na(pw$coresident_child_raw) &
          !(pw$coresident_child_raw %in% c(0, 1)))) {
    stop("Unexpected coresident_child code in year ", yr)
  }

  person_wave_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- pw
}

person_wave <- do.call(rbind, person_wave_list)
person_wave <- person_wave[order(person_wave$individual_id, person_wave$wave), ]
rownames(person_wave) <- NULL

# Verify that a standardized person does not switch household IDs in these five files.
hh_per_person <- tapply(person_wave$household_id,
                        person_wave$individual_id,
                        function(z) length(unique(z[!is.na(z)])))
bad_household_switch <- names(hh_per_person)[hh_per_person > 1]
if (length(bad_household_switch) > 0) {
  stop("At least one individual is linked to more than one household_id. ",
       "This A-version script intentionally stops rather than forcing a household chain.")
}
```

```{r}
# 4. Household-wave Dibao and income histories
# ---------------------------
# First check that repeated respondents within a household-wave carry
# a single non-missing household value.
check_household_value <- function(df, variable, yr) {
  ss <- split(df[[variable]], df$household_id)
  n_unique <- vapply(ss, function(z) length(unique(z[!is.na(z)])), integer(1))
  if (any(n_unique > 1)) {
    stop("Conflicting non-missing ", variable,
         " values within household-wave in year ", yr)
  }
}

hh_wave_list <- list()
for (yr in waves) {
  d <- person_wave[person_wave$wave == yr, ]
  check_household_value(d, "dibao", yr)
  check_household_value(d, "household_income_per_capita", yr)

  hh_split <- split(d, d$household_id)
  hh_one <- lapply(hh_split, function(g) {
    data.frame(
      household_id = g$household_id[1],
      wave = yr,
      dibao = one_nonmissing(g$dibao),
      household_income_per_capita = one_nonmissing(g$household_income_per_capita),
      any_alive_record = any(g$death == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  hh_wave_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- do.call(rbind, hh_one)
}

household_wave <- do.call(rbind, hh_wave_list)
rownames(household_wave) <- NULL

# Important implementation detail:
# A missing Dibao value on a death-only row is NOT treated as an observed
# "Unknown Dibao response". It simply means Dibao was not observed in that
# household-wave. A missing Dibao value counts as an ambiguous observed wave
# only when the household has at least one alive/respondent record in that wave.
# This prevents Exit/death-only records from mechanically moving prior Never
# households into Unknown.

hh_split <- split(household_wave, household_wave$household_id)
household_history <- do.call(rbind, lapply(hh_split, function(g) {
  any_yes <- any(g$dibao == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  any_no <- any(g$dibao == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  ambiguous_observed <- any(g$any_alive_record & is.na(g$dibao))

  if (any_yes) {
    group <- "Ever"
    first_wave <- min(g$wave[g$dibao == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else if (any_no && !ambiguous_observed) {
    group <- "Never"
    first_wave <- NA_real_
  } else {
    group <- "Unknown"
    first_wave <- NA_real_
  }

  inc <- g$household_income_per_capita
  data.frame(
    household_id = g$household_id[1],
    dibao_group = group,
    first_dibao_wave = first_wave,
    long_mean_household_income_pc =
      if (all(is.na(inc))) NA_real_ else mean(inc, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_income_waves = sum(!is.na(inc)),
    n_household_waves = nrow(g),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(household_history) <- NULL

# ---------------------------
# 5. Fixed sex and death-time information at person level
# ---------------------------
person_split <- split(person_wave, person_wave$individual_id)

person_meta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(person_split, function(g) {
  g <- g[order(g$wave), ]
  sx <- g$sex[!is.na(g$sex)]
  data.frame(
    individual_id = g$individual_id[1],
    household_id = g$household_id[1],
    sex_fixed = if (length(sx) == 0) NA_real_ else sx[1],
    sex_conflict = length(unique(sx)) > 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(person_meta) <- NULL

# There should be at most one wave in which a person is recorded as dead.
death_count <- vapply(person_split,
                      function(g) sum(g$death == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                      numeric(1))
if (any(death_count > 1)) {
  stop("At least one person has death==1 in more than one wave.")
}

death_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(person_split, function(g) {
  g <- g[order(g$wave), ]
  dead_rows <- g[g$death == 1, , drop = FALSE]
  alive_rows <- g[g$death == 0, , drop = FALSE]
  last_alive_wave <- if (nrow(alive_rows) == 0) NA_real_ else max(alive_rows$wave)

  if (nrow(dead_rows) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      individual_id = g$individual_id[1],
      death_confirmed = 0,
      death_report_wave = NA_real_,
      death_time_raw = NA_real_,
      death_time = NA_real_,
      death_source_raw = NA_character_,
      death_time_source = NA_character_,
      death_time_issue = NA_character_,
      last_alive_wave = last_alive_wave,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  d <- dead_rows[1, ]
  report_wave <- d$wave
  previous_alive <- alive_rows$wave[alive_rows$wave < report_wave]
  last_alive_before_report <-
    if (length(previous_alive) == 0) NA_real_ else max(previous_alive)

  raw_time <- NA_real_
  raw_source <- "missing"

  if (!is.na(d$death_year)) {
    if (!is.na(d$death_month) && d$death_month >= 1 && d$death_month <= 12) {
      # Midpoint of the reported month on a decimal-year scale.
      raw_time <- d$death_year + (d$death_month - 0.5) / 12
      raw_source <- "reported_year_month"
    } else {
      raw_time <- d$death_year
      raw_source <- "reported_year"
    }
  } else if (!is.na(d$birth_year_used) && !is.na(d$age)) {
    # The cleaned death age is already encoded in the cleaned files.
    raw_time <- d$birth_year_used + d$age
    raw_source <- "cleaned_death_age"
  }

  valid_raw <- !is.na(raw_time) &&
    raw_time <= report_wave &&
    (is.na(last_alive_before_report) || raw_time > last_alive_before_report)

  if (valid_raw) {
    final_time <- raw_time
    final_source <- raw_source
    issue <- NA_character_
  } else {
    if (is.na(raw_time)) {
      issue <- "death_time_missing"
    } else if (raw_time > report_wave) {
      issue <- "death_time_after_report_wave"
    } else if (!is.na(last_alive_before_report) &&
               raw_time <= last_alive_before_report) {
      issue <- "death_time_not_after_last_alive"
    } else {
      issue <- "death_time_invalid"
    }

    # Explicit fallback rather than a silent correction.
    if (!is.na(last_alive_before_report)) {
      final_time <- (last_alive_before_report + report_wave) / 2
      final_source <- "fallback_midpoint"
    } else {
      final_time <- report_wave
      final_source <- "fallback_first_dead_wave"
    }
  }

  data.frame(
    individual_id = g$individual_id[1],
    death_confirmed = 1,
    death_report_wave = report_wave,
    death_time_raw = raw_time,
    death_time = final_time,
    death_source_raw = raw_source,
    death_time_source = final_source,
    death_time_issue = issue,
    last_alive_wave = last_alive_wave,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(death_info) <- NULL

# Attach household history to persons.
person_meta <- merge(person_meta, household_history,
                     by = "household_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
person_meta <- merge(person_meta, death_info,
                     by = "individual_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Create start-stop person-period records
# ---------------------------
start_data <- person_wave[person_wave$wave %in% start_waves &
                          person_wave$death == 0, , drop = FALSE]

start_data <- merge(start_data,
                    person_meta[, c("individual_id", "household_id",
                                    "sex_fixed", "sex_conflict",
                                    "dibao_group", "first_dibao_wave",
                                    "long_mean_household_income_pc",
                                    "n_income_waves",
                                    "death_confirmed", "death_report_wave",
                                    "death_time", "death_time_source",
                                    "death_time_issue", "last_alive_wave")],
                    by = c("individual_id", "household_id"),
                    all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

start_data$next_wave <- unname(next_wave_lookup[as.character(start_data$wave)])
start_data$observation_end <- ifelse(start_data$death_confirmed == 1,
                                     start_data$death_time,
                                     start_data$last_alive_wave)
start_data$stop <- pmin(start_data$next_wave,
                        start_data$observation_end,
                        na.rm = FALSE)

start_data$event <- ifelse(
  start_data$death_confirmed == 1 &
    !is.na(start_data$death_time) &
    start_data$death_time > start_data$wave &
    start_data$death_time <= start_data$stop,
  1L, 0L
)

start_data$marriage_status <- recode_marriage(start_data$marriage_status_raw)
start_data$living_children <- recode_children(start_data$num_children)
start_data$coresident_child <- recode_coresidence(start_data$coresident_child_raw)
start_data$age_group <- recode_age_group(start_data$age)
start_data$sex <- factor(ifelse(start_data$sex_fixed == 1, "Male",
                                ifelse(start_data$sex_fixed == 2, "Female", NA)),
                         levels = c("Male", "Female"))

# Sequential eligibility flags used for QA/sample flow.
start_data$eligible_group <- start_data$dibao_group %in% c("Ever", "Never")
start_data$eligible_age <- !is.na(start_data$age) & start_data$age >= 45
start_data$eligible_sex <- !is.na(start_data$sex_fixed)
start_data$eligible_income <- !is.na(start_data$long_mean_household_income_pc)
start_data$after_ever_entry <- start_data$dibao_group != "Ever" |
  (!is.na(start_data$first_dibao_wave) &
     start_data$wave >= start_data$first_dibao_wave)
start_data$positive_interval <- !is.na(start_data$stop) &
  start_data$stop > start_data$wave

analysis_intervals <- start_data[
  start_data$eligible_group &
    start_data$eligible_age &
    start_data$eligible_sex &
    start_data$eligible_income &
    start_data$after_ever_entry &
    start_data$positive_interval,
  , drop = FALSE
]

analysis_intervals$start <- analysis_intervals$wave
analysis_intervals$person_years <- analysis_intervals$stop - analysis_intervals$start
```


```{r}
# 7. Common household income tertiles for Ever + Never
# ---------------------------
# Cutoffs are calculated once, from unique eligible households represented
# in the combined Ever + Never person-period analysis sample.
cutoff_households <- unique(
  analysis_intervals[, c("household_id", "long_mean_household_income_pc")]
)
cutoff_households <- cutoff_households[
  !is.na(cutoff_households$long_mean_household_income_pc), , drop = FALSE]

income_cutoffs <- quantile(
  cutoff_households$long_mean_household_income_pc,
  probs = c(1/3, 2/3),
  na.rm = TRUE,
  type = 7,
  names = FALSE
)
q1 <- income_cutoffs[1]
q2 <- income_cutoffs[2]

analysis_intervals$income_tertile <- ifelse(
  analysis_intervals$long_mean_household_income_pc <= q1, "T1",
  ifelse(analysis_intervals$long_mean_household_income_pc <= q2, "T2", "T3")
)
analysis_intervals$income_tertile <- factor(
  analysis_intervals$income_tertile,
  levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3")
)

analysis_intervals$dibao_group <- factor(
  analysis_intervals$dibao_group,
  levels = c("Never", "Ever")
)

# Re-assert factor reference levels after merges/subsetting.
analysis_intervals$sex <- factor(analysis_intervals$sex,
                                 levels = c("Male", "Female"))
analysis_intervals$marriage_status <- factor(
  analysis_intervals$marriage_status,
  levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced",
             "Never married", "Unknown")
)
analysis_intervals$living_children <- factor(
  analysis_intervals$living_children,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
)
analysis_intervals$coresident_child <- factor(
  analysis_intervals$coresident_child,
  levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
)
analysis_intervals$age_group <- factor(
  analysis_intervals$age_group,
  levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+")
)

# ---------------------------
# 8. QA tables and common sample summary
# ---------------------------
group_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Ever", "Never"), function(gr) {
  d <- analysis_intervals[as.character(analysis_intervals$dibao_group) == gr,
                          , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    dibao_group = gr,

    households = length(unique(d$household_id)),

    person_years = sum(d$person_years, na.rm = TRUE),
    death_events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

income_cutoff_table <- data.frame(
  cutoff = c("33.333%", "66.667%"),
  value = c(q1, q2),
  method = "R quantile(type = 7), unique eligible households",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

sample_flow <- data.frame(

          start_data$eligible_sex),
    sum(start_data$eligible_group & start_data$eligible_age &
          start_data$eligible_sex & start_data$eligible_income),
    sum(start_data$eligible_group & start_data$eligible_age &
          start_data$eligible_sex & start_data$eligible_income &

)

sex_conflict_qa <- person_meta[person_meta$sex_conflict,
                               c("individual_id", "household_id",

death_time_qa <- death_info[!is.na(death_info$death_time_issue), ]

death_source_qa <- as.data.frame(table(

names(death_source_qa) <- c("death_time_source", "n_persons")

# 9. Ever Dibao analysis data and rare-marriage handling

ever_data_all <- analysis_intervals[
  as.character(analysis_intervals$dibao_group) == "Ever", , drop = FALSE
]

# Keep Unknown in the common data and QA, but do not estimate a Cox coefficient

marriage_unknown_excluded <- ever_data_all[

ever_data <- ever_data_all[

# Re-assert model reference levels.
```

```{r}

# 10. Ever Dibao main Cox model
# ---------------------------
main_formula <- Surv(start, stop, event) ~
  sex + income_tertile + marriage_status + living_children +
  coresident_child + strata(age_group)

main_fit_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(main_formula, ever_data)
main_fit <- main_fit_obj$fit
main_results <- extract_cox_results(main_fit)
main_results_readable <- make_readable_main_results(main_results)

# PH diagnostic: robust fit first; exact-formula non-cluster fallback only if needed.
main_ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(main_formula, ever_data, main_fit)
main_ph <- main_ph_diag$object
main_ph_table <- main_ph_diag$table

ph_diagnostic_info <- data.frame(
  model = "Ever main Cox",
  diagnostic_source = main_ph_diag$source,
  primary_error = ifelse(is.na(main_ph_diag$primary_error),
                         "", main_ph_diag$primary_error),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------
# 11. Auxiliary Sex x Marital status model
# ---------------------------
# This is a secondary analysis. To avoid separation/infinite coefficients,
# only marital-status categories with >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL
# deaths in BOTH men and women are allowed into the interaction model.
sex_marriage_cell_qa <- make_sex_marriage_cell_qa(ever_data)

marital_nonref <- setdiff(levels(ever_data$marriage_status), "Partnered")
supported_marital_levels <- character(0)

for (lev in marital_nonref) {
  z <- sex_marriage_cell_qa[
    sex_marriage_cell_qa$marriage_status == lev &
      sex_marriage_cell_qa$sex %in% c("Male", "Female"),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(z) == 2 &&
      all(z$events >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL)) {
    supported_marital_levels <- c(supported_marital_levels, lev)
  }
}

sex_marriage_level_eligibility <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(marital_nonref, function(lev) {
    z <- sex_marriage_cell_qa[
      sex_marriage_cell_qa$marriage_status == lev &
        sex_marriage_cell_qa$sex %in% c("Male", "Female"),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    data.frame(
      marriage_status = lev,
      male_events = if (any(z$sex == "Male"))
        z$events[z$sex == "Male"][1] else NA_real_,
      female_events = if (any(z$sex == "Female"))
        z$events[z$sex == "Female"][1] else NA_real_,
      eligible_for_sex_interaction =
        lev %in% supported_marital_levels,
      rule = paste0(">=", MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL,
                    " deaths in each sex-specific cell"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

sex_marriage_fit <- NULL
sex_marriage_coefficients <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_block <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_level_HRs <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_ph <- NULL
sex_marriage_ph_table <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_warnings <- character(0)

if (length(supported_marital_levels) > 0) {
  sex_marriage_data <- ever_data[
    as.character(ever_data$marriage_status) %in%
      c("Partnered", supported_marital_levels),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]
  sex_marriage_data <- droplevels(sex_marriage_data)
  sex_marriage_data$sex <- factor(sex_marriage_data$sex,
                                   levels = c("Male", "Female"))
  sex_marriage_data$marriage_status <- factor(
    sex_marriage_data$marriage_status,
    levels = c("Partnered", supported_marital_levels)
  )

  sex_marriage_formula <- Surv(start, stop, event) ~
    sex * marriage_status + income_tertile + living_children +
    coresident_child + strata(age_group)

  sex_marriage_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(
    sex_marriage_formula, sex_marriage_data
  )
  sex_marriage_fit <- sex_marriage_obj$fit
  sex_marriage_warnings <- sex_marriage_obj$warnings
  sex_marriage_coefficients <- extract_cox_results(sex_marriage_fit)

  interaction_terms <- grep(":", names(coef(sex_marriage_fit)), value = TRUE)
  sex_marriage_block <- wald_block(
    sex_marriage_fit, interaction_terms
  )
  sex_marriage_block$test <-
    "Sex x Marital status overall interaction (eligible levels only)"
  sex_marriage_block <- sex_marriage_block[
    , c("test", "chisq", "df", "p_value")
  ]

  # Marital-status HRs within men and women, each versus Partnered.
  for (lev in supported_marital_levels) {
    main_term <- paste0("marriage_status", lev)

    male_row <- linear_combination_hr(
      sex_marriage_fit,
      setNames(1, main_term),
      paste0("Male: ", lev, " vs Partnered")
    )

    possible_interactions <- c(
      paste0("sexFemale:marriage_status", lev),
      paste0("marriage_status", lev, ":sexFemale")
    )
    int_term <- possible_interactions[
      possible_interactions %in% names(coef(sex_marriage_fit))
    ]

    if (length(int_term) == 1) {
      female_row <- linear_combination_hr(
        sex_marriage_fit,
        setNames(c(1, 1), c(main_term, int_term)),
        paste0("Female: ", lev, " vs Partnered")
      )
    } else {
      female_row <- data.frame(
        label = paste0("Female: ", lev, " vs Partnered"),
        log_HR = NA_real_, SE = NA_real_, HR = NA_real_,
        lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_
      )
    }

    sex_marriage_level_HRs <- rbind(
      sex_marriage_level_HRs, male_row, female_row
    )
  }

  sex_marriage_ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
    sex_marriage_formula, sex_marriage_data, sex_marriage_fit
  )
  sex_marriage_ph <- sex_marriage_ph_diag$object
  sex_marriage_ph_table <- sex_marriage_ph_diag$table
} else {
  sex_marriage_block <- data.frame(
    test = "Sex x Marital status overall interaction",
    chisq = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_,
    note = "Not fitted: no non-reference marital level met the event-count rule.",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  sex_marriage_ph_table <- data.frame(
    term = "NOT_FITTED",
    chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
    message = "Sex x Marital status model not fitted because of sparse cells.",
    diagnostic_source = NA_character_,
    primary_error = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 12. Cell counts / sparse-data QA
# ---------------------------
qa_variables <- c("sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
                  "living_children", "coresident_child", "age_group")
cell_qa <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(qa_variables, function(v) make_cell_qa(ever_data, v))
)
sparse_qa <- cell_qa[cell_qa$events < 5, , drop = FALSE]

model_warning_table <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    rep("Ever main model", length(main_fit_obj$warnings)),
    rep("Ever Sex x Marriage model", length(sex_marriage_warnings))
  ),
  warning = c(main_fit_obj$warnings, sex_marriage_warnings),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (nrow(model_warning_table) == 0) {
  model_warning_table <- data.frame(
    model = "None",
    warning = "No coxph warnings captured",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
# 0. Settings
# ---------------------------
DATA_DIR <- "."

                                               logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

library(openxlsx)

# Diagnostic-driven modeling settings
# Marriage Unknown is retained in the common data/QA, but excluded from Cox models
# because the current Ever sample contains only one Unknown interval/person/event.

# 1. Small helper functions
# ---------------------------
first_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  x[1]
}

one_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  x[1]
}

safe_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

standardize_2011_individual_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- x
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 11
  out[idx] <- paste0(substr(x[idx], 1, 9), "0", substr(x[idx], 10, 11))
  out
}

standardize_2011_household_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- x
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 9
  out[idx] <- paste0(x[idx], "0")
  out
}

recode_marriage <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[x %in% c(1, 2, 7)] <- "Partnered"
  out[x == 5] <- "Widowed"
  out[x %in% c(3, 4)] <- "Separated-Divorced"
  out[x == 6] <- "Never married"
  factor(out,
         levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced",
                    "Never married", "Unknown"))
}

recode_children <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 0] <- "0"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 1] <- "1"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 2] <- "2"
  out[!is.na(x) & x >= 3] <- "3+"
  factor(out, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown"))
}

recode_coresidence <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 0] <- "No"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 1] <- "Yes"
  factor(out, levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))
}

# HUKOU: 1 = agricultural; 2 = non-agricultural (reference).
recode_hukou <- function(x) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 1] <- "Agricultural"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 2] <- "Non-agricultural"
  factor(out, levels = c("Non-agricultural", "Agricultural"))
}

recode_age_group <- function(x) {
  cut(x,
      breaks = c(45, 55, 65, 75, 85, 95, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74",
                 "75-84", "85-94", "95+"))
}

fit_cox_with_warnings <- function(formula, data) {
  warnings_seen <- character(0)
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(formula,
          data = data,
          ties = "efron",
          cluster = individual_id,
          robust = TRUE,
          x = TRUE,
          model = TRUE),
    warning = function(w) {
      warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings_seen))
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit)
  coef_table <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
  ci_table <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)

  out <- data.frame(
    term = rownames(coef_table),
    beta = coef_table[, "coef"],
    HR = ci_table[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower_95 = ci_table[, "lower .95"],
    upper_95 = ci_table[, "upper .95"],
    p_value = coef_table[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if ("robust se" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "robust se"]
  } else if ("se(coef)" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "se(coef)"]
  } else {
    out$robust_se <- NA_real_
  }

  out[, c("term", "beta", "robust_se", "HR",
          "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")]
}

wald_block <- function(fit, coefficient_names) {
  b_all <- coef(fit)
  coefficient_names <- intersect(coefficient_names, names(b_all))

  if (length(coefficient_names) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  b <- b_all[coefficient_names]
  V <- vcov(fit)[coefficient_names, coefficient_names, drop = FALSE]

  ok <- is.finite(b)
  if (!all(ok)) {
    b <- b[ok]
    V <- V[ok, ok, drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (length(b) == 0 || any(!is.finite(V))) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  ee <- eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE)
  tol <- max(abs(ee$values)) * 1e-10
  keep <- ee$values > tol
  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  Vinv <- ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE] %*%
    diag(1 / ee$values[keep], nrow = sum(keep)) %*%
    t(ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE])

  W <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% Vinv %*% b)
  df <- sum(keep)
  p <- pchisq(W, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  data.frame(chisq = W, df = df, p_value = p)
}

linear_combination_hr <- function(fit, weights, label) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)
  w <- rep(0, length(b))
  names(w) <- names(b)

  missing_terms <- setdiff(names(weights), names(b))
  if (length(missing_terms) > 0 || any(!is.finite(b[names(weights)])) ||
      any(!is.finite(V[names(weights), names(weights), drop = FALSE]))) {
    return(data.frame(label = label, log_HR = NA_real_, SE = NA_real_,
                      HR = NA_real_, lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_,
                      p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  w[names(weights)] <- weights
  est <- sum(w * b)
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(w) %*% V %*% w))
  z <- est / se

  data.frame(
    label = label,
    log_HR = est,
    SE = se,
    HR = exp(est),
    lower_95 = exp(est - 1.96 * se),
    upper_95 = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
}

safe_cox_zph <- function(fit) {
  tryCatch(
    cox.zph(fit, transform = "km", terms = TRUE, global = TRUE),
    error = function(e) structure(list(message = conditionMessage(e)),
                                 class = "cox_zph_error")
  )
}

ph_table <- function(ph_object) {
  if (inherits(ph_object, "cox_zph_error")) {
    return(data.frame(term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
                      chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
                      message = ph_object$message,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  x <- as.data.frame(ph_object$table)
  x$term <- rownames(x)
  rownames(x) <- NULL
  x[, c("term", setdiff(names(x), "term")), drop = FALSE]
}

make_cell_qa <- function(data, variable) {
  levs <- levels(data[[variable]])
  if (is.null(levs)) levs <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[variable]])))

  out <- lapply(levs, function(z) {
    d <- data[as.character(data[[variable]]) == z, , drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(
      variable = variable,
      level = z,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

add_sheet <- function(wb, name, x) {
  addWorksheet(wb, name)
  writeData(wb, name, x)
}


# Pretty, reader-facing version of the main Cox table.
make_readable_main_results <- function(x) {
  label_map <- c(
    "sexFemale" = "Female vs Male",
    "income_tertileT2" = "Income T2 vs T1",
    "income_tertileT3" = "Income T3 vs T1",
    "marriage_statusWidowed" = "Widowed vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced" = "Separated/Divorced vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusNever married" = "Never married vs Partnered",
    "living_children1" = "1 living child vs 0",
    "living_children2" = "2 living children vs 0",
    "living_children3+" = "3+ living children vs 0",
    "living_childrenUnknown" = "Living children Unknown vs 0",
    "coresident_childYes" = "Coresident child Yes vs No",
    "coresident_childUnknown" = "Coresident child Unknown vs No",
    "hukouAgricultural" = "Agricultural Hukou vs Non-agricultural Hukou"
  )

  out <- x
  out$comparison <- ifelse(out$term %in% names(label_map),
                           unname(label_map[out$term]),
                           out$term)
  out$HR_95CI <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
                         out$HR, out$lower_95, out$upper_95)
  out$p_display <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$p_value), NA_character_,
    ifelse(out$p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", out$p_value))
  )
  out[, c("comparison", "HR_95CI", "p_display",
          "beta", "robust_se", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")]
}

make_sex_marriage_cell_qa <- function(data) {
  sexes <- levels(data$sex)
  marriages <- levels(data$marriage_status)
  grid <- expand.grid(
    sex = sexes,
    marriage_status = marriages,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    sx <- grid$sex[i]
    ms <- grid$marriage_status[i]
    d <- data[
      as.character(data$sex) == sx &
        as.character(data$marriage_status) == ms,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    data.frame(
      sex = sx,
      marriage_status = ms,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

# Run cox.zph on the clustered robust fit first.
# If the robust covariance is singular, fit the exact same Cox formula without
# cluster/robust ONLY for the PH diagnostic and label this fallback explicitly.
run_ph_diagnostic <- function(formula, data, clustered_fit) {
  primary <- safe_cox_zph(clustered_fit)

  if (!inherits(primary, "cox_zph_error")) {
    tab <- ph_table(primary)
    tab$diagnostic_source <- "clustered robust Cox fit"
    tab$primary_error <- NA_character_
    return(list(object = primary, table = tab,
                source = "clustered robust Cox fit",
                primary_error = NA_character_))
  }

  diagnostic_fit <- coxph(
    formula,
    data = data,
    ties = "efron",
    x = TRUE,
    model = TRUE
  )
  fallback <- safe_cox_zph(diagnostic_fit)
  tab <- ph_table(fallback)
  tab$diagnostic_source <- "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback"
  tab$primary_error <- primary$message

  list(object = fallback, table = tab,
       source = "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback",
       primary_error = primary$message)
}

print_table_section <- function(title, x, digits = 4) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(title, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No result available.\n")
  } else {
    print(x, row.names = FALSE, digits = digits)
  }
}

# 2. Read and standardize the five cleaned files
# ---------------------------
raw_list <- list()
id_qa <- list()

for (yr in waves) {
  f <- input_files[as.character(yr)]
  d <- read.csv(f,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                na.strings = c("", "NA"),
                colClasses = c(individual_id = "character",
                               household_id = "character",
                               community_id = "character"),
                check.names = FALSE)

  required_now <- c("individual_id", "household_id", "community_id",
                    "sex", "age", "marriage_status_raw",
                    paste0("hukou_", yr),
                    paste0("death_", yr), paste0("dibao_", yr),
                    "num_children", "coresident_child",
                    "household_income_per_capita")
  missing_now <- setdiff(required_now, names(d))
  if (length(missing_now) > 0) {
    stop("Year ", yr, " is missing required column(s): ",
         paste(missing_now, collapse = ", "))
  }

  d$individual_id <- trimws(d$individual_id)
  d$household_id <- trimws(d$household_id)
  d$community_id <- trimws(d$community_id)

  before_ind_lengths <- table(nchar(d$individual_id), useNA = "ifany")
  before_hh_lengths <- table(nchar(d$household_id), useNA = "ifany")

  if (yr == 2011) {
    d$individual_id <- standardize_2011_individual_id(d$individual_id)
    d$household_id <- standardize_2011_household_id(d$household_id)
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(d$individual_id)) {
    stop("Duplicated individual_id detected after standardization in year ", yr)
  }

  after_ind_lengths <- table(nchar(d$individual_id), useNA = "ifany")
  after_hh_lengths <- table(nchar(d$household_id), useNA = "ifany")

  id_qa[[as.character(yr)]] <- data.frame(
    year = yr,
    rows = nrow(d),
    unique_individuals = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    unique_households = length(unique(d$household_id)),
    individual_length_before = paste(names(before_ind_lengths), before_ind_lengths,
                                     sep = ":", collapse = "; "),
    individual_length_after = paste(names(after_ind_lengths), after_ind_lengths,
                                    sep = ":", collapse = "; "),
    household_length_before = paste(names(before_hh_lengths), before_hh_lengths,
                                    sep = ":", collapse = "; "),
    household_length_after = paste(names(after_hh_lengths), after_hh_lengths,
                                   sep = ":", collapse = "; ")
  )

  raw_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- d
}

# Successive-wave ID matching QA
```
